verdict.rationale: The quickstart shows a non-boolean string feature read with `useFeatureValue("button-color", "blue")`. The docs also describe rules that override a feature's default value and targeting that controls "which values a user sees", and experiment rules assign users across multiple variations, so the core of multivariate, value-based flags is covered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of number and JSON value types, and independent or hands-on corroboration of serving structured config values.
